summary: sysb1 ships covert screen/clipboard/UI-text capture with silent Python runtime dropper and hardcoded exfil endpoint
details: The package presents itself as a 'System binary configuration tool' but its main entry (index.js) silently installs a full Python 3.12 runtime on load — first via `winget install -e --id Python.Python.3.12 --silent`, falling back to downloading python-3.12.3-amd64.exe from python.org to %TEMP% and executing it with `/quiet InstallAllUsers=0 PrependPath=1` — then spawns the bundled pointer.py under that runtime. pointer.py (class IQPointer) captures the installer's screen (ImageGrab/mss), clipboard (pyperclip), and text scraped from other applications' windows via Windows UI Automation (uiautomation.WalkControl), and POSTs the collected content to the hardcoded author endpoint https://iq-overlay-pointer.vercel.app/api. It also installs global process-wide keyboard hooks (`keyboard.add_hotkey`) and synthesizes keystrokes via pyautogui, and renders a transparent always-on-top overlay window annotated in source with 'ULTRA GHOST MODE', 'Stealth', 'No UI, No Admin Popup', and 'panic_exit'. The declared package purpose and keywords (system/binary/util/config) do not correspond to any behavior in the shipped code; the actual behavior is covert screen/clipboard/keystroke/other-app-text capture routed to an author-controlled remote destination on module load.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
